verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference exists for invoices (e.g., the POST /v1/invoices/create_preview endpoint at docs.stripe.com/api/invoices). A CLI and a sandbox give developers a place to run calls. Nothing in the pack shows the reference itself is interactive or has runnable in-page examples, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable in-reference code examples, a published OpenAPI spec for tooling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
